recipes.title: Lemon ricotta pasta
recipes.description: Silky, bright and ready in twenty minutes

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta until just al dente.
Whisk ricotta, lemon zest, lemon juice, olive oil and a splash of pasta water until creamy.
Add the drained pasta and toss gently. Loosen with more pasta water as needed.
Finish with parmesan, torn basil, black pepper and a little olive oil.

recipes.title: Roasted harvest bowl
recipes.description: Crisp vegetables, grains and green tahini

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 220°C. Dice the sweet potato and season with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Roast the sweet potato and chickpeas for 25–30 minutes until golden.
Cook quinoa according to the packet instructions and fluff with a fork.
Stir tahini with lemon juice and water. Build bowls with quinoa, vegetables and sauce.

recipes.title: Overnight berry oats
recipes.description: A make-ahead breakfast with a little crunch

instructions.text: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds and maple syrup in a jar.
Stir well, cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least four hours.
Top with berries and a spoonful of yogurt before serving.

recipes.title: Slow Sunday tomato soup
recipes.description: A comforting bowl with toasted sourdough

instructions.text: Soften the onion in olive oil, then add garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and stock. Simmer gently for 25 minutes.
Blend until smooth, stir in cream and season to taste.
Serve hot with toasted sourdough and fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Gujarati dhokla
recipes.description: Soft, savory steamed dhokla with a light tempering

instructions.text: Mix gram flour, curd and water into a smooth batter.
Fold in ginger and seasoning, then rest the batter briefly.
Steam until cooked through and finish with a light tempering.
